svg.aria-label: Mirage – a living Spicetify theme. Spotify as frosted glass, recoloured by every album cover, cycling through the schemes Mirage, Obsidian, Sakura, Abyss and Ember.

g.text: Spotify as frosted glass – every song repaints
the whole interface in its album colours.
Live colours from the album cover
Background that breathes on the beat
Desktop overlay for every song change
